description: Traffic Citations - Memphis Police Department is a dataset listed in Datamidsouth open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by City of Memphis. Dataset contains information about moving traffic citations issued by the Memphis Police Department (MPD). It is limited to electronically issued citations. As of mid-2023, electronically issued citations are estimated to represent 90% of all citations issued. Each row is an electronic traffic citation issued by MPD. Coverage: Memphis and the Mid-South. The portal files it under Justice & Safety. Its keywords are Driver, Ticket, Automobile, Car. The portal shows 706,910 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-datamidsouth-org-portal.
